title: Agent Squad manifest
description: Schema for an Agent Squad bundle's manifest.json — the package descriptor. Per-agent runtime config lives in agents/<id>/agent.json, validated separately by agent.schema.json. Source of truth for validation is apps/marketplace/src/services/manifest.ts — this file mirrors it for bundle authors.

author.description: GitHub username or org. v1: pancake-official.

skills.description: Bundle-relative paths to squad-wide skill files.

items.description: Kebab-case agent id, unique within the squad. Each id must have a matching agents/<id>/agent.json file.

agents.description: List of agent ids declared by this squad. Per-agent config lives in agents/<id>/agent.json.

workflows.description: Outcome-typed entrypoints the squad publishes — its public interface. The cofounder delegates by creating a board ticket that names a workflow id + inputs and assigns it to the workflow's agent; the agent runs it via its own skills. Inline metadata (not file paths) so the cofounder's catalog can be built without reading extra files.

id.description: Stable workflow id, lower-kebab/dotted, e.g. github.triage_issue. Unique within the squad.

summary.description: One line the cofounder reads to match intent → workflow.

inputs.description: Map of input name → type/description string, e.g. { "repo": "string", "issue_number": "int" }. Optional.

outcome.description: The defined outcome / done-state, e.g. "issue labeled with a P0–P3 criticality + assessment filed".

agent.description: The squad agent that runs this workflow — must be one of manifest.agents. The cofounder assigns the ticket to this agent.

required_tool_permissions.description: Enforced — each value must be an accepted Pancake tool key. See docs/bundle-reference.md for the canonical list.

min_pancake_version.description: Informational only in v1 — the pod has no semantic version.
